text: Master the solid basic theory and systematic specialized knowledge of this discipline, have the feelings of family and country, a high sense of social responsibility and broad academic vision, have the ability to engage in scientific research in management science and engineering disciplines, and become a socialist builder and successor with all-round development of morality, intelligence, physical fitness, the United States and labor. Specifically, it includes: (1) Systematically master and thoroughly understand the way of thinking, methods and technologies of management science, and be able to use appropriate qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to solve practical management problems; (2) Comprehensively and deeply grasp the research results in this field and understand the development trends of related disciplines; (3) Master relatively standardized research methods and be able to undertake certain scientific research tasks independently; (4) Master a foreign language and be able to read foreign language materials of the subject skillfully.
